title: leads are counted apart from documents to decide
line: a person four links from the confirmed tree is not named for a real, undecided card that waits on them, nor passed over; one whose only open work is a lead (a memorial's listed relative, tools/plan.py's listed_relative_leads) is neither named nor passed over either, since Catalog.waiting never counts a lead as a document and the queue never adds a confirmed person on a lead's account alone

steps.say: a census page names and cites four people, none yet decided: a real document waits on each, and the nearest of them is two links from the home person, the only one confirmed

expect.why: Alicia Ahern's card is a real document to decide, but she is four links from the confirmed tree: she is no one at its edge, and her card waits with her; the queue names only the home person, whose key facts are undecided

steps.say: a memorial's listed relative is a lead, hand-planted here as tools/plan.py would write one, on a person with nothing else open

expect.why: the lead is counted apart from documents to decide

a lead is not a document, a conflict, or an undecided key fact, so the queue never puts this person up at all: not named next, and not named among those passed over either, exactly as before the lead existed
